name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods

items_removed_on_completion.basis: Derived, not explicit: MeowDB's quest database "Requirement type" filter treats item requirements as hand-ins (quests whose requirements are all items are listed as "Item hand-in only", items plus kills as "Items + monster kills"). MeowDB has no field saying which items are taken on completion.

journal.raw:
Pio in Amherst wants you to help collect recycled goods.
I ran into Pio, who's famous in Amherst for fixing broken things. He asked me to break down wooden boxes from around town and bring back Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards.
I broke wooden boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because I found other useful items in the boxes as well.

lines.text: My goodness. I've been wandering around town, and I see so many recyclable items just being thrown away! Say, can you help me collect some of them? Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your effort.

I don't know if you saw any abandoned wooden boxes on your way here, but your job is to break those boxes apart into Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards. Collect 3 of each for me, okay?

gaps: MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.

MeowDB has no explicit "items removed on completion" field; items_removed_on_completion is derived from MeowDB's quest database "Requirement type" filter, which labels item requirements "Item hand-in only" / "Items + monster kills".
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.
